Economy & Markets.title: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the September 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 46% YES on this outcome.

Economy & Markets.title: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the September 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 52% YES on this outcome.

Economy & Markets.title: Fed rate hike in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 70% odds of a rate hike. Tighter policy strengthens the dollar and pressures grain export competitiveness.

Economy & Markets.title: Will no Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 93% odds of a rate cut. Lower rates reduce operating loan and land interest carrying cost -- historically supportive of commodity prices via weaker dollar.

Weather & Climate.title: Will Kansas have D4 (Exceptional Drought) this week?
Weather & Climate.why_it_matters: Drought is the single biggest yield risk -- it moves corn and bean prices fast.
